purpose: Private-first SearXNG web search and bounded public web-content extraction.

provides.name: web_search
provides.description: Run one web search through the configured SearXNG service. Make parallel protocol calls for multiple independent queries.

query.description: Non-empty search query of at most 2000 characters.

max_results.description: Number of results from 1 to 20; defaults to 5.

provides.name: fetch_content
provides.description: Fetch and locally extract bounded readable content from one public HTTP(S) URL or PDF. Private destinations are rejected and optional Jina fallback is controlled only by JINA_ENABLED.

url.description: Non-empty public HTTP(S) URL of at most 8192 characters.

max_chars.description: Maximum total returned characters from 1 to 50000; defaults to 12000.
